run_ImplicitronTrainingLoop_run: run the ImplicitronTrainingLoop training and validation loop with a model, optimizer, scheduler, and data loaders
load_ImplicitronTrainingLoop_load_stats: load training stats from a checkpoint file to resume training at a specific epoch
run_ImplicitronTrainingLoop_training_or_: run a single training or validation epoch with forward pass, loss computation, and backward pass
save_ImplicitronTrainingLoop_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint and stats object to disk with optional old checkpoint purging
create_TrainingLoopBase_subclass: create a custom training loop subclass extending TrainingLoopBase with run and load_stats methods
